listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Honey Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Marc Jacobs Honey Eau de Parfum is a bright, feel-good fragrance that captures warmth, energy and a touch of playfulness. The scent opens with juicy pear and mandarin, bringing an immediate burst of sweetness and light. This soft fruitiness moves into a heart of apricot, peach nectar, honeysuckle and orange blossom, creating a floral-fruity blend that feels uplifting without being overpowering. In the dry down, honey, golden vanilla and smooth woods add a comforting, gently sensual depth that lingers beautifully on the skin.Ideal for those who enjoy cheerful, feminine fragrances with a modern twist, this eau de parfum works well for everyday wear and relaxed evenings alike. It sits comfortably within a fragrance wardrobe as a go-to option when you want something optimistic and inviting. Spritz onto pulse points as the final step in your routine to complement skincare and make-up, or use alone whenever you’d like a soft, radiant scent that feels both cosy and full of life.Why we love it- Combines juicy pear and mandarin with florals and honey for a cheerful, uplifting scent.- The blend of apricot, peach nectar and honeysuckle adds a soft, feminine sweetness without feeling heavy.- Honey, golden vanilla and smooth woods in the base create a warm, comforting trail that wears beautifully day or night.- Easy to wear as an everyday signature fragrance or as a mood-boosting spritz for special occasions.How to useHow to Use:Apply to clean, dry skin. Hold the bottle a few inches away and spray Marc Jacobs Honey Eau de Parfum onto pulse points such as the wrists, neck and behind the ears. Allow the fragrance to settle on the skin without rubbing. Reapply if desired.Frequency:Use as needed, according to the product instructions.Application Technique:Spray a light mist directly onto pulse points, taking care not to oversaturate the skin or clothing. For a more diffused effect, mist the fragrance into the air and walk through the cloud.Best Practices:Apply after bathing or moisturising to help the scent cling to the skin. Start with a small amount and build if you prefer a stronger presence. Store the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight to help preserve the fragrance.Safety Tips:For external use only. Avoid spraying directly into the eyes or on irritated skin. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children and follow any additional guidance on the packaging.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Pleasures For Men Eau de Cologne Spray 100ml
listings.description: A refreshing breath of energy carried in a crisp, clean fragrance. Pleasures for Men reflects the highs of life, bringing a warm and woody freshness that keeps the senses sharp and alert.Openings of citrus, nectarine, green leaves and a sky air accord provide an uplifting top. Spicy middle notes combine pimento with coriander and red ginger. Deeper base notes use sandalwood with forest moss and luxurious ebony.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Youth Dew Eau de Parfum Spray 67ml
listings.description: Youth-Dew is an amber spicy fragrance for women designed by Estée Lauder in 1953 and is recommended as an evening fragrance. Middle notes are cloves, jasmine, lily of the valley, orchid, rose, cassia, ylang ylang and cinnamon.

Couture Couture Eau de Parfum works well as a personal treat or as a thoughtful gift for someone who appreciates stylish, statement fragrances from Juicy Couture.Why we love it- Designed as a confident, fashion-forward fragrance that suits those who enjoy a statement scent- Eau de parfum concentration offers a richer, longer-lasting trail on the skin- 100ml size is ideal for regular use, whether for evenings out or special occasions- Pairs easily with an existing beauty routine as a finishing touch after skincare and make-upHow to useHow to Use:Apply Couture Couture Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml to clean, dry skin. Spray lightly onto pulse points such as the wrists, neck and behind the ears. Allow the fragrance to settle before dressing to help it develop fully.Frequency:Use as needed, according to personal preference and the product instructions.Application Technique:Hold the bottle a short distance from the skin and spray a fine mist onto the chosen areas. Avoid rubbing the fragrance in, as this may alter how it develops on the skin.Best Practices:Apply after bathing or showering, once skin is dry, to help the scent cling for longer. Start with a small amount and build up if a more noticeable fragrance is desired. Store the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.Safety Tips:For external use only. Avoid spraying directly into the eyes or on irritated skin. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children and follow any additional guidance on the packaging.

listings.rawTitle: Boucheron Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 100ml
listings.description: Boucheron Pour Femme is a floral amber fragrance that was launched in 1988. The scent opens with top notes of tangerine, bitter orange, galbanum, tagetes, basilica and apricot. Middle notes are Moroccan jasmine, ylang-ylang, narcissus and orange blossom. Base notes are tonka bean, sandalwood and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Clarins Eau des Jardins Treatment Fragrance 100ml / 3.3 fl.oz.
listings.description: Clarins Eau des Jardins Treatment Fragrance is a refreshing way to fragrance the skin while enjoying a touch of skincare comfort. This uplifting aromatic mist blends notes of sparkling citrus fruits, delicate rose and soft woods with plant extracts such as Blackcurrant, Beech and Sorbier, which are known for their moisturising and soothing properties. The lightweight liquid texture leaves skin lightly scented, feeling soft and comfortable, and is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive.Ideal for those who enjoy a fresh, garden-inspired scent, this fragrance fits effortlessly into a daily body care ritual. It can be misted on after a morning shower, used as a daytime pick-me-up, or layered over body lotion to enhance both scent and softness. The gentle, non-photosensitising formula is designed to be worn generously on the body, helping to promote a sense of well-being while giving the skin a subtly radiant feel. Housed in a bottle made with recycled glass, it also appeals to those who value considered, eco-minded beauty choices.Why we love it- Combines a fresh blend of citrus, rose and soft woody notes with plant extracts for skin that feels lightly hydrated and comforted.- Works as both a fragrance and a body treatment, helping to leave skin feeling soft, smooth and subtly radiant.- Gentle, non-photosensitising formula that’s suitable for all skin types, including sensitive, making it easy to wear every day.- Eco-conscious bottle made with recycled glass appeals to those who enjoy sensorial beauty with a more mindful approach.How to useHow to Use:Apply after bathing or showering. Hold the bottle a few inches from the body and spray Eau des Jardins Treatment Fragrance onto clean, dry skin. Reapply during the day whenever a refreshing boost of scent and comfort is desired.Frequency:Use as needed throughout the day, according to personal preference.Application Technique:Mist the fragrance over areas such as the neck, décolleté, arms and torso, allowing the fine spray to settle on the skin. For a more enveloping effect, spray in a cloud in front of you and walk through the mist. The product is designed to be left on the skin and not rinsed off.Best Practices:Apply to clean skin so the fragrance sits well and lasts longer. Allow the mist to dry before dressing. You may layer over matching body products to enhance both scent and softness. Store the bottle away from direct sunlight and heat.Safety Tips:For external use only. Avoid spraying directly into the face or eyes. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children and follow any additional guidance on the packaging.

listings.rawTitle: Dior Forever and Ever Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Forever and Ever Eau de Toilette Spray is a soft, romantic floral fragrance that feels effortlessly wearable every day. The scent centres on delicate freesia and jasmine petals, wrapped in the gentle sweetness of Bulgarian rose to create a tender, feminine trail that’s elegant rather than overpowering. It’s a beautiful choice if you enjoy light, graceful florals that still feel special, whether for daytime, the office or relaxed evenings out.Designed as an eau de toilette, the fragrance offers a fresh, airy presence on the skin with a medium intensity that’s easy to reapply as desired. A few sprays on pulse points, such as the wrists, neck and décolleté, help to enhance the natural warmth of the skin and release the floral notes gradually through the day. Forever and Ever Eau de Toilette Spray fits seamlessly into a fragrance wardrobe as a go-to signature for those moments when you want to feel quietly polished and softly sophisticated.Why we love it- Showcases a tender blend of freesia, jasmine and Bulgarian rose for a soft, romantic floral scent- Medium eau de toilette intensity makes it comfortable for everyday wear without feeling heavy- Works beautifully as a signature fragrance for those who prefer light, feminine florals- Easy-to-wear spray format that can be refreshed throughout the day to suit your routineHow to useHow to Use:Apply to clean, dry skin. Spray Forever and Ever Eau de Toilette onto pulse points such as the wrists, neck and behind the ears. Reapply lightly during the day if you’d like to refresh the fragrance.Frequency:Use as needed.Application Technique:Hold the bottle a few inches away from the skin and spray in a light mist over pulse points. Allow the fragrance to settle without rubbing, so the notes can develop naturally.Best Practices:Apply after bathing or moisturising to help the scent cling to the skin. Avoid spraying directly onto delicate fabrics or jewellery. Store the bottle away from direct sunlight and heat to help preserve the fragrance.Safety Tips:For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes and irritated skin. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children and follow any additional guidance on the product packaging.

listings.rawTitle: Creed Acqua Fiorentina Eau de Parfum Spray 75ml
listings.description: A rebirth of inspiration portrayed within the elegant nuances of fragrance. Acqua Fiorentina celebrates the renewal of culture within the 15th century and more specifically it pays homage to the city and countrysides of Florence in Italy. Plucking fresh fruit from the finest of orchards: succulent apples and plums combine with the tangy freshness of citrus and a bed of flowers highlighted in rose.Top notes: Greengage plum and apple.Middle notes: Rose, white carnation, bergamot and lemon.Base notes: Cedar, sandalwood and white grapefruit.

listings.rawTitle: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Aftershave Balm 100ml
listings.description: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Aftershave Balm 100ml is a comforting post-shave step inspired by the iconic Le Male fragrance. Designed to be used after shaving, this balm helps to soothe the feel of freshly shaved skin while lightly veiling it in the familiar blend of lavender and vanilla associated with the Le Male universe. The texture is that of a soft balm, created to leave skin feeling smoother, more comfortable and subtly scented rather than heavy or greasy.Ideal for those who enjoy a classic, masculine fragrance with a sensual twist, this product fits easily into a daily grooming routine. Apply it after cleansing and shaving to help calm the sensation of razor drag and to add a refined finishing touch before fragrance. Worn alone or layered with Le Male Eau de Toilette or other products from the Le Male line, the balm helps to extend the scent experience while supporting skin that feels freshly cared for and ready for the day or evening ahead.Why we love it- Combines post-shave comfort with the signature Le Male blend of lavender and vanilla for a subtly sensual finish.- Balm texture is designed to leave freshly shaved skin feeling smoother, softer and more comfortable.- Works seamlessly in a daily grooming routine, used after shaving and before applying fragrance.- Ideal for fans of Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male who want to extend their favourite scent beyond the fragrance itself.How to useHow to Use:After shaving, rinse and gently pat the skin dry. Smooth a small amount of Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Aftershave Balm over the shaved areas of the face and neck. Allow the balm to absorb fully before applying any additional products or fragrance.Frequency:Use after each shave or as needed, according to the product instructions.Application Technique:Apply to clean, dry skin using clean hands. Massage the balm in gentle, upward motions over the shaved areas until it is fully absorbed, avoiding direct contact with the eyes and lips.Best Practices:For best cosmetic results, shave on cleansed skin, then follow with this balm as the final step in the shaving routine before applying fragrance. Use a moderate amount rather than over-applying, and allow a few moments for the texture to settle on the skin before dressing.Safety Tips:Use externally only. Avoid contact with eyes; if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water. Discontinue use if irritation occurs and keep out of reach of children. Always follow any additional guidance on the product packaging.
